purpose: Run the same retained Elm preview policy in a native-owned persistent JavaScriptCore worker, with exact owned context/thread, immutable input/output custody and no renderer authority or ordinal issuance. Couple original compiled policy to actual original C/Native synthetic peer while recreating renderer transport contexts. Native owns policy lifetime outside WebKit renderer loss; actual WebKit routing/visual projection, host input backpressure and delayed refusal outcomes remain separate activation gates.
